how: Vendors submit results on standardized reference implementations under audited rules in twice-yearly rounds; results are peer-reviewed before publication.
name: MLPerf Training
note: The de facto standard for comparing training silicon and systems across NVIDIA, Google, AMD, Intel, and others.
measures: Time-to-train: how fast a hardware and software system trains reference models, including large language model workloads, to a fixed quality target.
not_measured: Inference speed, cost, energy per query, or developer experience; results reflect tuned flagship submissions, not typical customer configurations.
